fable.w: This section is a list of supplemental appropriation amounts for salaries, expenses, and activities of HEW components, with transfers from Social Security trust funds. The tempting reading is that references to "civil rights educational activities" or "Indian health activities" imply engagement with outside groups, but these are only names of appropriation accounts. Nothing here requires or authorizes consultation, hearings, comment, rulemaking, advisory bodies, or suits involving any party outside the federal government.

qwen_block.w: This section consists entirely of appropriation language, listing specific dollar amounts allocated to various federal agencies and offices for salaries, expenses, and specific activities. It does not establish any process for consulting with or coordinating with non-federal entities, nor does it create advisory boards, public comment periods, or rights to sue. The text describes internal funding mechanisms within the federal government.
qwen_block.s: Office of Education: “Salaries and expenses”, $740,000; “Civil rights educational activities”, $28,000;

opus.w: This section only sets supplemental appropriation amounts for HEW offices and approves transfers from Social Security trust funds. It does not create any process that brings outside parties into a federal decision. Line items such as "civil rights functions" or "Indian health activities" are funding categories, not consultation with or participation by people outside the government.
opus.b: This is a list of supplemental appropriation amounts for offices within the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare. One tempting reading is to treat the "civil rights functions" or the "Indian health activities" line items as a sign of outside involvement. That reading fails because these are just funding lines. Nothing here requires or allows any consultation, hearing, comment period, or advisory body involving people outside the federal government. The only transfers mentioned move money between federal trust funds and federal appropriations, so they stay inside the government.

It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. Nothing. The text is purely a list of budget appropriations for various federal agencies and offices.
qwen_chat.s: Office of Education: “Salaries and expenses”, $740,000; “Civil rights educational activities”, $28,000; Public Health Service: “Hospitals and medical care”, $2,478,000;
